title: Fleet telemetry LLM ops pilot - statement of work and rate card
body:
Overview:

This draft SOW covers a 10-week pilot engagement with a national logistics operator to evaluate a lightweight LLM-based operations assistant that consumes vehicle telemetry and driver event streams to provide: anomaly triage, short-form incident summaries, and routing/dispatch suggestions for human operators. The goal is to validate feasibility, ingestion patterns, quantize costs, and recommend a production deployment mode (hosted API, Dedicated pool, or Private VPC).

Primary objectives:
- Build a telemetry ingestion adapter prototype that normalizes vehicle CAN/OBD messages and GPS streams into event summaries consumable by an LLM.
- Produce an LLM prompt + toolchain that outputs: (1) incident summaries (2) severity classification (3) recommended next action (dispatch/cancel/monitor).
- Run a 2,000-event evaluation corpus through the pipeline, measure latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), per-unit token costs, and quality metrics (precision of classification, summary ROUGE/EM proxies).
- Deliver a deployment recommendation with cost projections and an initial rollout plan for customer ops.

Scope of work (phases):
Phase 0 — Kickoff & data discovery (Week 0–1):
- Kickoff workshop (2 hrs) with ops, infra, and data teams.
- Inventory of telemetry sources, retention windows, and PII-sensitive fields.
- Access checklist for sample streams (SFTP/HTTP/Kinesis).

Phase 1 — Ingestion & normalization prototype (Week 2–3):
- Lightweight adapter (Python) to map raw telemetry to canonical event JSON (timestamp, lat/lon, speed, fault-codes, driver-id-hash).
- Local staging with replay capability and simple streaming harness.
- Deliverable: adapter repo + README + sample normalized dataset (2k events).

Phase 2 — LLM pipeline + toolcalling prototype (Week 4–6):
- Design prompt templates and deterministic tool wrappers (geofence checks, nearest-depot lookup, severity heuristics).
- Run inference against curated model variants (open 7B/13B quantized variants + Redwood-verified low-latency hosted profile).
- Measure response latency and token usage across models and batching configs.
- Deliverable: evaluation report with latency/cost/quality tradeoffs and recommended model+quantization profiles.

Phase 3 — Workshop, ops playbook, and deployment recommendation (Week 7–8):
- 1-day hands-on workshop to validate playbooks with customer ops and SRE.
- Create runbook for incident handling and model fallback policies (dedicated->hosted fallback).
- Produce a deployment pad with architecture diagrams for three modes: Hosted API, Dedicated GPU pool, Private VPC.

Phase 4 — Pilot run & acceptance (Week 9–10):
- 2-week pilot against a shadow traffic slice (non-production) of ~2k events/day.
- Acceptance criteria: p95 inference latency < 850ms (for Dedicated/Hosted proof), classification precision >= 88% on labeled sample, and no PII leakage observed in generated summaries.
- Deliver final SOW appendix: cost projection, SLA targets, and recommended next steps.

Deliverables:
- Code: ingestion adapter + LLM pipeline samples (MIT-licensed sample code)
- Evaluation report: latency, cost per 1k events, model quality metrics and sample outputs
- Ops playbook: runbooks, rollback/fallback configuration, monitoring checklist
- Pricing appendix: rate card and estimate for 3 deployment options
- Workshop notes and annotated decision logs

Pricing (high level / draft):
- Professional services (eng + se): 10-week effort at hourly blended rate of $250/hr. Estimated 350 hours -> $87,500 (fixed-fee milestone billing).
- Pilot resources: provided by Redwood for evaluation (up to 2 dedicated GPU-days equivalent time across the evaluation window) included in PS. Overage billed at $1,200 per GPU-day.
- If customer selects Dedicated: one-time onboarding & capacity setup fee $60,000 + monthly committed capacity starting at $18,000/mo (50 GPU-hours equivalent).
- If customer selects Private VPC: enterprise on-prem packaging starting at $150,000 (lump-sum) + annual support $30,000.
- Hosted API: pay-as-you-go token pricing (estimate for pilot traffic ~ $2,500/month at 100% hosted) — see appendix table for model-by-model per-1k token sample.
- Optional: 1-day on-site workshop (travel exp + $6,000/day)

Assumptions and constraints:
- Customer supplies sample telemetry feed with required redaction/PII hashing applied, or grants access to a staging feed behind a short-term NDA.
- Customer maintains a single point-of-contact for data access and decision sign-off.
- Pilot will not include direct integration into live dispatch systems; recommendations only.

Risk register (short):
- Data quality & schema drift — mitigant: normalization heuristics + replay test harness.
- Unexpected PII in free-text fields — mitigant: automated scrubber + manual sample audit.
- Latency spikes under real burst patterns — mitigant: stress tests and autoscaling guidance.

Acceptance criteria (detailed):
- Functional: system produces incident summary and classification for >= 95% of events in sample corpus.
- Quality: classification precision >= 88% and recall >= 75% on labeled subset.
- Performance: p95 latency < 850ms for recommended deployment mode during shadow traffic; cost-per-1k-events documented.
- Security: no PII exfiltration found in two-pass manual review of 200 generated outputs.

Technical approach notes (engineering thinking / workarounds):
- Prefer prefix-caching for repeated vehicle context to reduce KV cache pressure (cost optimization).
- Use continuous batching with adaptive max-batch-size per second to balance p95 latency and cost.
- For Private deployments, recommend mixed-precision quantized models (int8) for fleet-scale cost efficiency.

Workshop agenda (half-day onsite or remote):
1) 30m: Kickoff and ops pain points
2) 45m: Telemetry walkthrough and data samples (hands-on replay)
3) 60m: LLM outputs and decision criteria (live demo)
4) 30m: Deployment options and costs
5) 15m: Next steps and action items

Next steps / proposed milestone billing schedule:
- Sign SOW & mutual NDA -> 50% deposit on PS ($43,750) -> begin Phase 0
- Phase 1 completion -> 20% milestone ($17,500)
- Phase 2 completion -> 20% milestone ($17,500)
- Final acceptance -> remaining 10% ($8,750)

Open questions for customer (to resolve pre-kickoff):
- Can you provide representative telemetry for at least 1 week of operations (anonymized)?
- Which security/compliance baseline applies (SOC2, HIPAA?).
- Are there existing geofencing or mapping APIs we need to integrate with?

Notes to self / internal TODOs:

- Create a short benchmark harness for p95 measurements (Lena to open PR).
